description: Scheduled Algo automations. scripts/setup_automations.py installs these as OpenClaw cron jobs, or as user crontab entries when OpenClaw is unavailable. {ROOT} is replaced with the checkout path at install time.

jobs.name: health
jobs.description: Read-only equity and options service, account, state, and risk-cycle health check every hour.

jobs.name: options-opening-capture
jobs.description: Save a separate Alpaca OPRA opening snapshot for the 117-symbol options research history universe.

jobs.name: options-history-capture
jobs.description: Start the same-session Alpaca OPRA option-chain capture before the market close.

jobs.name: ThetaData historical options backfill
jobs.description: Resume historical ThetaData EOD quote and open-interest archives across the 117-symbol research universe.

jobs.name: llm-driven
jobs.description: Hourly 04:00-20:00 ET on weekdays: refresh the swing_llm_driven snapshot, including owned-position reviews. Silent; fails loudly only.

jobs.name: llm-digest
jobs.description: Weekdays 07:45 ET: one briefing from the latest snapshot: owned positions, keep or sell, and the market context.

jobs.name: options-research
jobs.description: Run python -m research.options for options research only; it does not change orders or equity state.

jobs.name: equity-research
jobs.description: Run python -m research.equity for equity AutoResearch only, separate from the options job.
